intro.en: Air sensors measure the temperature and relative humidity around your crop. CropWatch shows those readings now and over time, and uses them to calculate VPD.

items.text: VPD, calculated from the two. See

alt.en: An air temperature and humidity sensor hanging at crop height in a greenhouse

content.text: Place the sensor at crop height, out of direct sun and away from heaters, vents and doors, so that it reads the air your plants actually experience.
A sensor in direct sunlight reads warmer than the air around it.
